projects.name: React Native Super App
projects.desc: A barcode scanner, ledger and ATM finder
projects.longDesc: This is a Super App made with React Native using Expo Go. It contains three different views: A barcode scanner made with Expo Camera, a simple ledger and an ATM finder that uses the device's location and a static JSON file containing the data of the ATM's.

projects.name: Chess Ratings (Frontend)
projects.desc: A program made for visualising ratings of chess players
projects.longDesc: A frontend version of a program made for visualising ratings of Lichess players. It sends requests to the Lichess API, which returns the rating histories of an account. Initially a full stack program, it was modified to a frontend site hosted on GitHub Pages. The [deployment](https://mywebsitearchive.github.io/chessratings-frontend/) is made using GitHub Actions.

projects.name: Kotlin Tennis Score Tracker
projects.desc: An Android exclusive tennis score tracker app made in Kotlin
projects.longDesc: My first project in Kotlin. I built this app in Android Studio, using my phone for debugging. It features a score tracker for a single tennis set and an undo function.

projects.name: Chess Ratings (Full Stack)
projects.desc: Full stack app for comparing Lichess ratings, made with Express.js, Vite and Prisma ORM
projects.longDesc: A program made for visualising ratings of Lichess players. The GUI, built with Vite using MUI X Charts, sends requests to the Express.js server, which in turn sends requests to the Lichess API and the Prisma ORM database.

projects.name: Math Game
projects.desc: GUI math game made with Tkinter in Python
projects.longDesc: Inspired by [Countdown](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Countdown_(game_show)#Numbers_round), the player tries to reach a number using basic mathematical operations in as few tries as possible. It features a backspace function to undo previous inputs.

projects.name: Discipline Tracker
projects.desc: A daily schedule planner, To Do list and habit tracker.
projects.longDesc: Mode 1: Plan your day by adding tasks to a list. The UI will show how much you have left until the next one. Mode 2: Add To Do's with a specified interval (7 days by default) to a list. The app shows how many days are remaining, and the timer can be reset once a task is completed. Mode 3: Add habits that you plan to break. It will show you how many days have passed, with the option to reset the timer. [Hosted online](https://mywebsitearchive.github.io/dailyschedule/).

projects.name: Automated Testing
projects.desc: Simple Selenium tests for the Discipline Tracker made in C# and JavaScript.
projects.longDesc: Inspired by a previous course on Robot Software, this repository has six tests for the Discipline Tracker written in both C# and JavaScript.
